entities.name: Oba, the dryad of life (a face of Trostani)

claims.subject: oba

evidence.quote: But this face of Trostani was responsible for Teysa's death, and so she didn't think a single look of shock was going to slow her down once she finally got free.
Murdered by a grief-poisoned Trostani who had been unable to tell friend from foe in the aftermath of the invasion.
Kaya circled the desk to Teysa's side, not letting herself touch the body again.

claims.summary: Teysa Karlov is murdered; the culprit is Oba, the dryad face of Trostani.

claims.subject: oba

evidence.quote: "Like all the deaths while you were gone?" asked Oba, the dryad of life.
But this face of Trostani was responsible for Teysa's death

claims.summary: Oba is one of the three dryad faces of Trostani (with Cim and Ses).

claims.subject: oba

evidence.quote: "I'm helping him find out who really killed Zegana."
"I know she was responsible. What I'm still missing is a large portion of the why.

claims.summary: Proft's investigation into Zegana's murder ends in Oba's unmasking as the killer of guild leaders.
claims.limitation: The cited quotes do not name Zegana and Oba in the same sentence; attribution comes from the investigation arc.

claims.subject: oba

evidence.quote: "Because they deserved it," snapped Oba, facade of calm finally shattering.
"They failed Ravnica in its time of greatest need," continued Oba.

claims.summary: Oba says she targeted the guild leaders because they failed Ravnica and Mat'Selesnya during the invasion.

claims.subject: kaya

evidence.quote: Together, Etrata and Kaya pulled the ribbons tighter and tighter—until they slipped out of Kaya's hands.
Snapping the newly flexible branch around, she whipped it into the mass of cords, using it to catch and confine the struggling dryad.

claims.summary: Kaya and Etrata bind Oba in Agency barrier wards at Vitu-Ghazi.

claims.subject: etrata

evidence.quote: The Dimir assassin, who had been lying motionless since she was impaled and had not been entwined by any of the roots that seized her allies, rolled onto her knees

claims.summary: Etrata, wounded, rises to help Kaya bind Oba.

claims.subject: azorius_senate

evidence.quote: But when the Azorius mages who had grabbed Etrata marched her to the gate and pulled her out, nothing stopped them

claims.summary: Azorius mages take Etrata into custody after the murder at Karlov Manor.

claims.subject: etrata

evidence.quote: "I'm helping him find out who really killed Zegana."
"Please. Like I'm going to let you get yourself slaughtered now, after I've worked so hard to keep you alive.

claims.summary: Etrata helps Proft find Zegana's real killer.

claims.subject: teysa_karlov

evidence.quote: Teysa, newest head of the Syndicate, stood on the manor's highest balcony

claims.summary: Teysa Karlov is the newest head of the Orzhov Syndicate.

claims.subject: alquist_proft

evidence.quote: Proft had been their asset before he chose to go off and ply his talents with the Agency

claims.summary: Alquist Proft works with the Agency.

claims.subject: kellan

evidence.quote: Kellan, the agent who had helped catch Etrata during the party.

claims.summary: Kellan is an Agency agent at Karlov Manor.

claims.subject: aurelia

evidence.quote: Kaya and Kellan were gaping at him when the door slammed open and Aurelia appeared, dragging a thrashing woman in Rakdos colors by the hair.
The chain connecting her to Massacre Girl—the captive who she had insisted on bringing

claims.summary: Aurelia captures Massacre Girl and keeps her chained as a captive.

claims.subject: izoni

evidence.quote: Izoni of the Golgari examined it on my behalf, and she was able to verify that while it is natural in origin
No one rose as high in their guild as Izoni had without some degree of pride.

claims.summary: Izoni is a high-ranking member of the Golgari who analyzes the poison evidence for Proft.
claims.limitation: Guild named only in dialogue; predicate 'joined' records membership, not a joining event.

claims.subject: vraska

evidence.quote: The previous guildmaster, Vraska, disappeared after the invasion ended and hasn't been seen since.

claims.summary: The guide says the Golgari's previous guildmaster, Vraska, disappeared after the invasion.
claims.limitation: Object is the guild she left; she disappeared after the Phyrexian invasion.

remaining: Episode 2 (Zegana's body) is not separately cited
Lazav's status remains unresolved and is not graded
